spans.s: N. of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ.

The orb of the moon; cf. also उर्गौरीपतिरुः कालः सेतुर्नाथः परायणः ।
 नारदोऽर्कोऽनिलः पाशी मार्कण्डेयोऽथ रावणः ॥ Enm. ━ind.
As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः Sk.

An interjection of:−
——(a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम

.
 or used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula
 implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I
 ask &c.); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो),
 न ({@नो@}) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ━उ ▪
 or उत on the one hand━on the other hand, partly━partly.

A protector; cf. ऊः परेतोऽण्डजस्त्वष्टा विवस्वानग्निसारथिः । वह्निर्निशाकरः
 पूर्णो दरिद्री सरमाधिपः ॥ Enm. ━ind.
A particle used to introduce a subject.
